items.headline: $ZEC Staking Upgrade Halted: Dev Calls It 'Not Good for Zcash'
items.summary: Key developer Josh Swihart paused the $ZEC Crosslink staking upgrade, warning it could harm Zcash. The clash is stirring debate across the privacy coin's community.

items.headline: $LIBRA Case Collapses: Judge Clears Milei of Fraud
items.summary: An Argentine judge ruled Milei's $LIBRA promo post didn't establish fraud, clearing him and 10 others. The memecoin saga that rocked Solana takes another twist.

items.headline: $HYPE Bulls Sweat as Hyperliquid Keeps Perps Crown
items.summary: Hyperliquid still dominates onchain perps volume, but $HYPE holders face mounting headwinds as momentum cools. Traders are watching key support levels.

items.headline: $XLM Posts Busiest Day of Month With 14.16M Transactions
items.summary: Stellar just logged 14.16 million transactions in a single day, its busiest of the month. Onchain activity for $XLM is quietly heating up.

items.headline: $DOGE Drama: Foundation Ends House of Doge Brand Deal
items.summary: The Dogecoin Foundation and House of Doge have ended their exclusive brand partnership. The split raises fresh questions about $DOGE ecosystem direction.
